pages.text: A single-rank ability for the Dragon Staff only. Costs one ability slot, one Nether Star, one Phantom Membrane, one Piercing enchanted book of any level, and 10 Redstone Blocks.

Right-click while riding a deployed stage-three or older dragon to toss a small enemy into the air, then spin and swat it with the tail. Hitting the ground deals additional blunt damage. The target must be smaller than an Iron Golem. The tail strike deals 50% of dragon attack damage once and launches the target. Ground impact within 3 seconds deals an additional 25% as blunt damage. Does not break blocks; each dragon has a 20-second cooldown.
